title: Close output inventory request v1
description: POST /internal/v1/jobs/{jobId}/outputs/close. The claiming invocation seals its output inventory once every output file is completed. No file list is accepted: the server closes exactly the files it reserved for this job. Idempotent for the same nonce.

invocationNonce.description: Fresh per physical invocation: 32 random bytes, unpadded base64url.

outcome.description: The outcome the worker will report. A failed run's inventory may contain partial clip files; they are retained for diagnostics and never accepted.
